newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's leading TV set maker Elemis goes bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: Poland's leading TV set maker Elemis goes bankrupt.

text.p: Warsaw commercial court declared on Friday the bankruptcy of WZT Elemis SA, until recently Poland's leading television set producer, the company's deputy president said.
Andrzej Michalik told Reuters that assets of the failed company, which had amassed 26 million zlotys in debts, could be used to set up a new venture.
"I believe that today's announcement of Elemis bankruptcy will pave the way for a creation of a new healthy venture better equipped to operate in market conditions," Michalik said.

Elemis, which was 60-percent owned by the state treasury and 33 percent owned by its employees with the remaining shares held by the company's creditors, saw its sales and financial results plunging over the last three years.

Michalik said Elemis, which was Poland's top producer in 1994 with output of 180,000 units and a net profit of four million zlotys, plunged into red last year when its production was halved to 80,000 units.
He said Elemis board sought to declare the company bankrupt after it failed to clinch a deal with its creditors.

According to industry analysts, Elemis' drop in sales and resulting financial woes can be partially blamed on an increasing domination of internationally-recognised brands on the Polish consumer electronics market.
"Over the last two years equipment made by international concerns has been selling better (than of domestic firms)," said Grzegorz Chechlacz from an independent Electronics Market Institute.
Chechlacz told Reuters international makers enjoyed better-brand recognition and were offering their products at similar prices as Polish makers.
The figures for 1995, the latest data available, show that sales of TV sets grew 17 percent to $640 million or 1.27 million units.
He said that in 1995 Elemis had an eight percent market share and ranked ahead of such giants as Philips and Sony, but lost its position to several foreign makers.
